server_bin.description: Full path to the remind executable used to run the daemon.

client_bin.description: Full path to the remind client executable (used for remote or interactive queries).

base_dir.description: Base directory for remind data files (e.g., reminder files, logs, cache).

rem_file.description: Path to the main reminder data file (e.g., .rem or .remind file).

log_file.description: Optional path to a log file for daemon output (empty = no logging).

pid_file.description: Path to the PID file used when running in daemon mode.

run_as_user.description: User account to run the remind daemon as (for security isolation).

run_as_group.description: Group to run the remind daemon as.

workers.description: Number of background worker processes. Set to 0 for single-process mode.

notify_timeout.description: Maximum time (in seconds) to wait for an alarm notification to execute before timing out.

daemon_mode.description: Whether to run remind as a background daemon (true) or as a foreground process (false).

verbose.description: Enable verbose logging for debugging and diagnostics.

sound_on_alarm.description: Whether to play a sound when an alarm triggers.

sound_cmd.description: Shell command to execute for alarm sound (only used if sound_on_alarm is enabled).

popup_on_alarm.description: Whether to show a desktop pop-up notification on alarm.

popup_cmd.description: Shell command template used to generate pop-up notifications (supports {{ message }} substitution).

name.description: A descriptive name for this channel (e.g., 'email', 'desktop', 'slack').

subject.description: Email subject line (required for email type).

body_template.description: Template for email body; use {{ message }}, {{ datetime }} placeholders (required for email type).

command.description: Shell command template for command-type channels (supports {{ message }}, etc.).

notification_channels.description: List of custom notification channels to trigger on alarms.

timezone.description: Time zone used to interpret and display times (e.g., 'America/Los_Angeles', 'UTC').

default_offset.description: Default time offset (in minutes) before an event to trigger a reminder (used for relative reminders).

enable_pre_reminders.description: Enable support for 'REM n BEFORE ...' style reminders (i.e., relative to event start time).

holidays_files.description: List of paths to holiday definition files (e.g., /usr/share/remind/holidays/world.cal).

scripts.description: List of paths to script files that define custom functions, macros, or logic.
